title: The Dynamic Doppler Spectrum Induced by Nonlinear Sensor Motion: Relativistic Kinematics and 4D Frenet-Serret Spacetime Geometry
summary: Fundamental to the analysis of nonlinear relativistic motion is the precise characterization of the induced dynamic Doppler effects. In this work, we analyze the electromagnetic signals observed by non-inertial receivers using two frameworks to describe the relativistic motion. We first consider observer paths described by higher-order kinematic 4 vectors: relativistic acceleration and jolt.
